Task Guide: Task: Your task is to calculate surface energy of Aluminum in (001) direction. Simulate a face-centered cubic (FCC) lattice structure for Aluminum using LAMMPS with a lattice constant of 4.05 angstrom. The simulation should use metal units, define a 5x5x5 simulation box, and set periodic boundary conditions to True in all directions. Perform energy minimization using the conjugate gradient method with a force tolerance of 1e-10, energy tolerance of 1e-10, maximum iterations of 1e+5, and maximum evaluations of 1e+5. After minimizing the bulk system, introduce a (001) surface by removing periodicity in the z-direction. Re-minimize the slab system and then compute the surface energy. As the final output, return the computed surface energy value in eV/Å² units. Make sure all the associated files for this task (input files, log files, any other files) are in the /results/md_tutorials/13_July_2025/react/gpt_4o/brief/task_4/task_4_trial_3 directory. You can use the available I/O tools (e.g., write_file) make new files .etc. Whatever potentials you need to run the simulation, you can find them at /potentials/. A type of potential can be accessed by /potentials/TYPE where TYPE can be [EAM, TERSOFF, REAXFF] which further contains the exact potential files. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL. If the task is to give the final output as a scalar, only return the numerical value, without any units.

Action Input: {"path": "/results/md_tutorials/13_July_2025/react/gpt_4o/brief/task_4/task_4_trial_3/in.al_surface_energy_surface", "content": "units metal
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic
lattice fcc 4.05
region box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box
mass 1 26.98
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 10
min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Save the minimized bulk energy
variable bulk_energy equal pe

# Create a surface by removing periodicity in z-direction
change_box all boundary p p f
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Save the minimized surface energy
variable surface_energy equal pe

# Calculate surface energy
variable area equal lx*ly
variable surf_energy equal (surface_energy - bulk_energy) / (2*area)
print 'Surface energy (eV/Å²) = ${surf_energy}'"}
